about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of cozy correspondence!

Carefully Stamped is a wholesome postcard-making sandbox game where you take on the charming job of a postcard designer. Craft delightful cards, decorate with adorable stickers, write sweet notes, and match the perfect stamp—all while enjoying relaxing tunes and satisfying vibes.

Whether you’re creating personalized mail for quirky customers or building your own dreamy stamp collection, there’s always a reason to send a little joy.

📮 Features

  • Craft & Sell: Take on customer orders and craft postcards that match their unique requests and personalities.
  • Design Freely: Decorate with a wide variety of cute stickers, washi tapes, doodles, and more!
  • Write Notes: Pen short, wholesome messages to make every postcard feel personal and heartfelt.
  • Collect Stamps: Unlock and collect a colorful assortment of stamps—from vintage vibes to quirky icons.
  • Wholesome Sandbox Mode: No timers. No pressure. Just cozy creativity and peaceful play.
  • Relaxing Soundtrack: Enjoy calming background tunes while you let your creativity flow.
  • Mailing Magic: Drop your finished postcards into the mailbox and watch them go on their way!

💌 A Game for Stationery Lovers

If you’ve ever fallen down a sticker organization rabbit hole or lost time browsing through cute stationery, this is the game for you. Carefully Stamped turns the art of mailing into a joyful experience.

So grab your favorite pen, pick out a stamp, and let the postcard magic begin!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
